name: Nicrosil
description: The Coppermind's toolkit: verify or reject drafts with one click, a review queue sidebar, flag resolving, hotkeys, a Dashboard with a live search box and a home button, a collapsible properties strip, a button that logs schema changes, a monthly log archive, an atlas of the wiki's topics, a Lens on each page's links, and a transcription queue that checks scans of handwritten notes against their transcriptions. Updates the page, index.md, and log.md.
author: Harrison Nickles
